name: A Trogg Idol of The Cleansing of Grimepit credits once however fast it is clicked (#10543)
contract: The Cleansing of Grimepit 175016 asks for five Trogg Idols 2300633 destroyed in Grimepit (objective 'Destroyed Trogg Idol 0/5'). One use of an idol destroys it: one idol is one credit.
The idol's SmartAI despawns it one second after use, and the goober has no auto-close, so during that second every further click credited the quest again and one idol completed it, as reported.

Expected: three clicks on the same idol in a row credit 1, not 3, and the idol disappears; after its two-minute respawn the same idol is usable again and credits the next use, so the in-use guard does not stick to the respawned idol (the #9476 failure). The camp's troggs are kept off with Divine Shield.
